natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down and inherited evidence indicates shorter onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption, while simplified signup durably lifted SMB activation. This directly addresses the activation and completion declines with a more sustainable mechanism than discounting. Verify both source records before finalizing scope and targeting.
